name: 86 Chaos 17.0.54
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.54
notes: Adds explicit LIVE and EMULATOR Firebase targets with LIVE remaining the default.
EMULATOR uses demo-86chaos and official Firestore, Auth, Functions, Realtime Database and Storage emulators before application traffic begins.
Release-gate Firebase clients, fixture seed/cleanup, Admin SDK, RTDB presence and secondary tenant Auth share the same fail-closed local target.
Cloud-only FCM, App Check, MFA fidelity, IAM and Vercel deployment identity remain explicit live-verification boundaries.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.54
summary: Adds a local, fail-closed Firebase Emulator Suite bridge for eligible release-gate and Playwright workflows without changing normal live Firebase behavior.
description: A surgical test-infrastructure release that keeps production behavior unchanged while allowing Yardmaster to select a demo-project Firebase Emulator Suite target.
highlights: Local emulator mode refuses non-loopback hosts and never silently falls back to chaos-test-d1601 or production.
Existing Firestore, Storage and RTDB security rules remain authoritative in emulator runs.
Mobile/iPhone-compatible startup regression coverage is retained.
